-- Spawns zombies at the arena edge, chases the nearest player, and applies blade damage.
-- Blades are moved client-side, so hits are computed here from the same shared orbit math.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local BladeConfig = require(Shared.Config).Blades
local Config = require(Shared.Config).Zombies
local BladeMath = require(Shared.BladeMath)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)
local Coins = require(script.Parent.Coins)
local Shop = require(script.Parent.Shop)

local bladesRoot = workspace:WaitForChild("Blades")

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Zombies"
folder.Parent = workspace

local alive = 0
local unspawned = 0
local lastAttacker: { [Model]: Player } = {}
local lastHit: { [Model]: { [string]: number } } = {}

-- The HUD reads these workspace attributes (they replicate, so no remote is needed).
local function publishZombiesLeft()
	workspace:SetAttribute("ZombiesLeft", unspawned + alive)
end

local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = pos
	part.Color = Config.Color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	return part
end

local function award(zombie: Model, position: Vector3)
	local player = lastAttacker[zombie]
	local stats = player and player.Parent and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		return
	end
	local coins = math.round(Config.CoinsPerKill * (1 + (player:GetAttribute("CoinBonus") or 0)))
	Coins.add(player, coins)
	Remotes.CombatFx:FireClient(player, "Coins", position, coins)
	stats.Kills.Value += 1

	local heal = player:GetAttribute("LifeSteal")
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if heal and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health += heal -- Humanoid clamps to MaxHealth
	end
end

local function spawnZombie(health: number)
	local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
	-- Square arena: project the random direction onto the square edge.
	local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
	local scale = Config.SpawnRadius / math.max(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Z))
	local pos = dir * scale + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)

	local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
	zombie.Name = "Zombie"

	local root = makePart("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos)
	local head = makePart("Head", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.75, 0))
	local legs = makePart("Legs", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	for _, part in { head, legs } do
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = root
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.Parent = part
	end
	root.Parent = zombie
	head.Parent = zombie
	legs.Parent = zombie

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.MaxHealth = health
	humanoid.Health = health
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.HipHeight = 2
	-- This rig has no Torso/Neck, so the default RequiresNeck would break the humanoid.
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	humanoid.Parent = zombie

	zombie.PrimaryPart = root
	zombie.Parent = folder
	root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

	alive += 1
	unspawned -= 1
	publishZombiesLeft()
	lastHit[zombie] = {}
	local finished = false
	local function finish()
		if finished then
			return
		end
		finished = true
		alive -= 1
		publishZombiesLeft()
		lastAttacker[zombie] = nil
		lastHit[zombie] = nil
	end
	-- Zombies removed without dying (e.g. falling out of the world) must still stop counting
	-- as alive, otherwise the wave never ends and the shop never opens.
	zombie.Destroying:Connect(finish)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if finished then
			return
		end
		local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
		if root then
			Remotes.CombatFx:FireAllClients("Kill", root.Position)
			award(zombie, root.Position)
		else
			award(zombie, Vector3.zero)
		end
		finish()
		task.delay(1, function()
			zombie:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end

local function nearestPlayerRoot(from: Vector3): BasePart?
	local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
			local dist = (hrp.Position - from).Magnitude
			if dist < bestDist then
				best, bestDist = hrp, dist
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Game over: every player has a character and all of them are dead.
-- Players still loading in have no character yet and must not trigger a reset.
local function everyoneDead(): boolean
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	if #players == 0 then
		return false
	end
	for _, player in players do
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health > 0 then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Waves: spawn the wave's quota (capped by MaxAlive at once), wait for it to be cleared, then break.
-- If everyone dies, the run is cleared and restarts at wave 1.
task.spawn(function()
	local wave = 1
	while true do
		local quota = Config.FirstWaveCount + Config.CountPerWave * (wave - 1)
		local health = Config.Health * (1 + Config.HealthGrowth * (wave - 1))
		local spawned = 0
		local gameOver = false
		unspawned = quota
		workspace:SetAttribute("Wave", wave)
		workspace:SetAttribute("BreakEndsAt", 0)
		publishZombiesLeft()
		while spawned < quota or alive > 0 do
			if everyoneDead() then
				gameOver = true
				break
			end
			if spawned < quota and alive < Config.MaxAlive and #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 then
				spawnZombie(health)
				spawned += 1
			end
			task.wait(Config.SpawnInterval)
		end
		if not gameOver then
			Shop.open()
			workspace:SetAttribute("BreakEndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + Config.WaveBreak)
			local breakEnds = os.clock() + Config.WaveBreak
			while os.clock() < breakEnds and not gameOver do
				gameOver = everyoneDead()
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
			Shop.close()
		end
		if gameOver then
			-- Destroying fires each zombie's finish(), which fixes the alive count.
			folder:ClearAllChildren()
			wave = 1
			-- Yield until someone has respawned; otherwise everyoneDead() ends the next wave
			-- instantly and this loop spins without yielding (script timeout).
			repeat
				task.wait(1)
			until not everyoneDead()
		else
			wave += 1
		end
	end
end)

-- Contact damage
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
		local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
		if not (humanoid and root) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= Config.ContactRadius then
				-- Not TakeDamage: it is blocked by ForceFields (e.g. spawn protection).
				hum.Health -= Config.ContactDamage * dt
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Chasing
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.2)
		for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
			local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
				local target = nearestPlayerRoot(root.Position)
				if target then
					humanoid:MoveTo(target.Position)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Blade hits
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local t = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local now = os.clock()

	for _, bladeFolder in bladesRoot:GetChildren() do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(bladeFolder.Name) or 0)
		local hrp = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not player or not hrp then
			continue
		end

		local count = #bladeFolder:GetChildren()
		local reach = player:GetAttribute("Reach") or 0
		local damage = BladeConfig.Damage * (1 + (player:GetAttribute("DamageBonus") or 0))
		for index = 1, count do
			local bladePos = hrp.Position + BladeMath.getOffset(index, count, t, reach)
			local key = bladeFolder.Name .. ":" .. index

			for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
				local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
				local hits = lastHit[zombie]
				if not (humanoid and root and hits) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
					continue
				end
				if (root.Position - bladePos).Magnitude > BladeConfig.HitRadius then
					continue
				end
				if now - (hits[key] or -math.huge) < BladeConfig.HitCooldown then
					continue
				end
				hits[key] = now
				lastAttacker[zombie] = player
				humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
				Remotes.CombatFx:FireAllClients("Hit", root.Position, damage)
			end
		end
	end
end)

20		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

66		local pool = table.clone(ShopConfig.Upgrades)
67		local result = {}
68		for _ = 1, math.min(ShopConfig.OfferCount, #pool) do

70			for _, upgrade in pool do

72			end

-- Between-wave upgrade shop. All state and purchase rules live on the server;
-- clients only display offers and send slot numbers.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)
local Coins = require(script.Parent.Coins)

local ShopConfig = Config.Shop

local isOpen = false
local offers: { [Player]: { { Id: string, Bought: boolean } } } = {}

local function bump(player: Player, name: string, amount: number, default: number)
	player:SetAttribute(name, (player:GetAttribute(name) or default) + amount)
end

local function applyMaxHealth(player: Player, heal: number?)
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Player.MaxHealth + (player:GetAttribute("BonusMaxHealth") or 0)
	if heal then
		humanoid.Health += heal
	end
end

-- Attributes replicate to clients, so visual ones (Reach, SpinMult) need no remote.
local effects = {
	Blade = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "BladeCount", amount, Config.Blades.StartCount)
	end,
	TwinSpin = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "BladeCount", amount, Config.Blades.StartCount)
	end,
	Damage = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "DamageBonus", amount, 0)
	end,
	Spin = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "SpinMult", amount, 1)
	end,
	Reach = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "Reach", amount, 0)
	end,
	Vitality = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "BonusMaxHealth", amount, 0)
		applyMaxHealth(player, amount)
	end,
	Vampiric = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "LifeSteal", amount, 0)
	end,
	Greed = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "CoinBonus", amount, 0)
	end,
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ShopConfig.Upgrades do
	byId[upgrade.Id] = upgrade
end

-- Weighted pick without replacement so a shop never shows the same upgrade twice.
local function roll(): { { Id: string, Bought: boolean } }
	local pool = table.clone(ShopConfig.Upgrades)
	local result = {}
	for _ = 1, math.min(ShopConfig.OfferCount, #pool) do
		local total = 0
		for _, upgrade in pool do
			total += ShopConfig.RarityWeight[upgrade.Rarity]
		end
		local pick = math.random() * total
		for i, upgrade in pool do
			pick -= ShopConfig.RarityWeight[upgrade.Rarity]
			if pick <= 0 or i == #pool then
				table.insert(result, { Id = upgrade.Id, Bought = false })
				table.remove(pool, i)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function send(player: Player)
	local list = {}
	for _, offer in offers[player] or {} do
		local upgrade = byId[offer.Id]
		table.insert(list, {
			Name = upgrade.Name,
			Rarity = upgrade.Rarity,
			Cost = upgrade.Cost,
			Description = upgrade.Description,
			Bought = offer.Bought,
		})
	end
	Remotes.ShopUpdate:FireClient(player, { Open = isOpen, RerollCost = ShopConfig.RerollCost, Offers = list })
end

local Shop = {}

function Shop.open()
	isOpen = true
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		offers[player] = roll()
		send(player)
	end
end

function Shop.close()
	isOpen = false
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		send(player)
	end
end

Remotes.ShopSync.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if isOpen and not offers[player] then
		offers[player] = roll()
	end
	send(player)
end)

Remotes.BuyOffer.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, slot)
	local list = offers[player]
	if not isOpen or not list or type(slot) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local offer = list[slot]
	if not offer or offer.Bought then
		return
	end
	local upgrade = byId[offer.Id]
	if not Coins.trySpend(player, upgrade.Cost) then
		return
	end
	offer.Bought = true
	effects[upgrade.Id](player, upgrade.Amount)
	send(player)
end)

Remotes.RerollOffers.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if not isOpen or not Coins.trySpend(player, ShopConfig.RerollCost) then
		return
	end
	offers[player] = roll()
	send(player)
end)

local function watchCharacter(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.defer(applyMaxHealth, player)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	watchCharacter(player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	offers[player] = nil
end)

return Shop

	local value = getValue(player)

	end

end

-- Server owns the blade parts (so later hit detection / upgrades live here).
-- The orbit motion itself is animated per-client; see client/BladeOrbit.client.lua.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config).Blades

local root = Instance.new("Folder")
root.Name = "Blades"
root.Parent = workspace

local function makeBlade(index: number): Part
	local blade = Instance.new("Part")
	blade.Name = "Blade" .. index
	blade.Size = Config.Size
	blade.Color = Config.Color
	blade.Material = Config.Material
	blade.Anchored = true
	blade.CanCollide = false
	blade.CanQuery = false
	blade.CastShadow = false
	blade:SetAttribute("Index", index)

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Config.Color
	light.Brightness = Config.LightBrightness
	light.Range = Config.LightRange
	light.Parent = blade

	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -Config.Size.Z / 2)
	a0.Parent = blade
	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, Config.Size.Z / 2)
	a1.Parent = blade

	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Attachment0 = a0
	trail.Attachment1 = a1
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.Color, Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255))
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
	trail.Lifetime = Config.TrailLifetime
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(Config.TrailWidth)
	trail.FaceCamera = true
	trail.Parent = blade

	return blade
end

local function setBladeCount(player: Player, count: number)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = tostring(player.UserId)
		folder.Parent = root
	end
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	for i = 1, count do
		makeBlade(i).Parent = folder
	end
end

local function setup(player: Player)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BladeCount"):Connect(function()
		setBladeCount(player, player:GetAttribute("BladeCount"))
	end)
	-- Upgrades raise this attribute; the signal above rebuilds the blades.
	player:SetAttribute("BladeCount", Config.StartCount)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end
end)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	setup(player)
end

UiKit.corner(barFill, 8)

local healthText = UiKit.label(barBack, "", 13, Theme.Text, true)
healthText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
healthText.ZIndex = 2

local function formatTime(seconds: number): string
	seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", seconds // 60, seconds % 60)
end

local function refreshWave()
	waveValue.Text = tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("Wave") or "-")
	zombiesValue.Text = tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("ZombiesLeft") or "-")
end

local function refreshTimer()
	local endsAt = workspace:GetAttribute("BreakEndsAt") or 0
	local remaining = endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if endsAt > 0 and remaining > 0 then
		timerValue.Text = formatTime(remaining)
		timerValue.TextColor3 = if remaining <= 5 then Theme.Danger else Theme.Accent
	else
		timerValue.Text = "FIGHT!"
		timerValue.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	end
end

local function refreshHealth()
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local health = humanoid and math.max(humanoid.Health, 0) or 0
	local maxHealth = humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth or 1
	local fraction = math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)
	barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
	barFill.BackgroundColor3 = if fraction <= 0.25 then Theme.Danger else Theme.Health
	healthText.Text = string.format("%d / %d", math.ceil(health), maxHealth)
end

local function refreshCoins()
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local value = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	coinsLabel.Text = tostring(value and value.Value or 0)
end

workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Wave"):Connect(refreshWave)
workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ZombiesLeft"):Connect(refreshWave)
player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Coins"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(refreshCoins)

-- Timer and health change continuously (Humanoid max/current are polled so respawns just work).
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	refreshTimer()
	refreshHealth()
end)

refreshWave()
refreshCoins()

**What I checked and found no bug in:**
- **Contact damage:** the damage loop in `Zombies.server.lua:212` reads the right config values and has no ForceField or other guard in its path. It only hurts you if a zombie gets within 4 studs. - **Shop:** it only opens after a wave is fully cleared (`Zombies.server.lua:187`). If the shop never appears, the wave probably isn't ending, so a zombie is likely stuck or not dying. The shop's own server and client code looks correct.
- **HUD:** I found nothing else wrong in the HUD code, and the wave and zombie counts come straight from workspace attributes.

1. Does the HUD show at all, even as "-" or "FIGHT!"? If not, a client script is failing early, so send me the Output errors.
